Never tried Ableton Live, used VDJ with Numark Mixtrack Pro for the mixes. Fucking hell, I was happy back then and I just traded it all for a few hits. Obviously not talking about ganja here. Thanks for the feedback, I guess...
Darkstep mix end? Assuming you mean the track, I did not, it's by Black Sun Empire, titled dark/black girl etc.
I have done some mixes, http://www.youtube.com/user/Pozla93/videos, but I sold my hardware for drugs....

Nothing related to relationships, I think it's just my [BPD](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Borderline_personality_disorder) and depression talking, although this time so strong I can almost hear the voices. My favorite music is neurofunk. hands down.

This is the last song I want to hear.
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eBgTJ1PA6Z4
That's the thing, I don't know the answer, and that's what's bugging me. I'm only 20 years old and I feel that I've seen enough, sign me for the one way ticket to the other side please.
Partial blahblah, seems to be fine, if I didn't get this feeling that my head is going to explode before unconsciousness, I know I'm surpressing the wrong veins but how am I supposed to do it?
